labkit.ui.plot.clampData

Clamp data coordinates inside the visible axes box.

Syntax

function xy = clampData(ax, xy, varargin)

Usage

xyOut = labkit.ui.plot.clampData(ax, xy)
xyOut = labkit.ui.plot.clampData(ax, xy, "Padding", 0.04)

Inputs

ax
target MATLAB axes or uiaxes handle.
xy
N-by-2 numeric data coordinates.
Padding
optional normalized axes padding, default 0.04.

Outputs

xyOut
N-by-2 clamped data coordinates.

Related APIs

  • labkit.ui.plot.clear — Clear a plot axes before app-owned redraws.
  • labkit.ui.plot.fit — Fit axes limits to finite plotted X/Y data.
